card.summary: Free Starter: up to 25 recordings per person, 5 minutes per video, 50 members. Not a storage quota. A recording-count quota.

free_tier.stated: Free Starter: up to 25 recordings per person, 5 minutes per video, 50 members. Not a storage quota. A recording-count quota.

record.tooling: yt-dlp `loom` extractor (verified present; `loom:folder` marked CURRENTLY BROKEN). Loom has no public upload API.
record.chaining: Free accounts are limited to 25 videos of up to 5 minutes each, yielding approximately 375 MB per account at standard bitrates.
record.limits_note: 25 videos and 5 minutes are the ceiling; both are product limits on recording, not storage, and the web uploader enforces the same shape.
record.reliability_note: Deletion of old recordings is the norm on free tiers; 25 slots means you must delete to re-record, so it can never accumulate.

card.summary: Loom Starter (free): up to 25 recordings per person, 5 min per screen recording, up to 720p; Loom Business is $18 per user / month with unlimited recordings....

free_tier.stated: Loom Starter (free): up to 25 recordings per person, 5 min per screen recording, up to 720p; Loom Business is $18 per user / month with unlimited recordings. Vidyard Free: 5 recorded videos a month and 30 minutes per recording; stored videos never expire and the library size is not limited. Neither page states a byte allowance.

limits.value: Loom Starter: up to 25 recordings per person, 5 min per video, up to 720p
Vidyard Free: 5 recorded videos a month, 30 min per recording, no limit on the number of stored videos

record.limits_note: Both plans cap by recording count and length, not bytes: Loom Starter 25 recordings per person of 5 min each, Vidyard Free 5 recorded videos a month of 30 min each.
record.reliability_note: Loom Starter caps recordings at 25 per person and 5 min each; Vidyard Free caps recorded videos at 5 a month and 30 min each, with no limit on the number of stored videos and no expiry. Neither page states a byte allowance.
record.confidence_note: documented: Loom Starter's recordings per person, length per video and quality, and the Business price, are quoted from https://www.loom.com/pricing; Vidyard Free's recordings a month, length limit and library size are quoted from https://knowledge.vidyard.com/hc/en-us/articles/360009875374 (both vendor pages read 2026-11-03); neither page states a byte allowance

evidence.proved: Both cap by recording COUNT and clip LENGTH rather than bytes (Loom 25 videos x 5 min; Vidyard 5/month, 25-slot library). Ceiling is a few hundred MB per account, unreachable toward 500 GB…
